title: Chihuahua Dog Tags for Tiny Tyrants | Salty Dog Tags
description: Funny chihuahua dog tags, laser engraved in Lehi, Utah. Tiny tags for tiny tyrants, with your dog's name and number on the back. From $12 a tag.
blurb: Engraved tags for a dog that weighs less than a pineapple and yells like it pays the mortgage. Our funny chihuahua tags say what your dog is already screaming at the mailman, just quieter.

hero.alt: Close-up of a laser-engraved dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number
hero.figcaption: Whisky's actual tag. He's a bulldog, but the laser doesn't care what breed you are.

tough.h2: Built for a dog that shakes 24/7
tough.html:
A chihuahua's tag gets rattled by nonstop shivering, rage-trembling at the neighbor's Lab, and the occasional zoomie under the couch. Add humidity, beach air and a spilled water bowl, and printed tags don't stand a chance.

We cut the words into the metal with a laser, so there's no ink to fade, peel or wash off.

Your dog will wear out its patience long before it wears out the tag.

How engraving holds up →

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. Our bulldogs outweigh a chihuahua about ten to one and still lose every argument with one at the dog park. These lines are for the winners.

sayings.h2: 8 chihuahua sayings for a dog that thinks it's a rottweiler
sayings.lead: Front of the tag. About the ankle-biting, the purse-riding, the shaking and the deep, personal hatred of everyone who isn't Mom. Name and number go on the back.
sayings.note: Every line above fits the tag as written. Want your own? Type it in the builder and the preview shows what fits before you pay.

guides.text: Dog Tag Size Guide by Breed

items.q: Will a tag bother my chihuahua?
items.a: A heavy one might. That's why we point small dogs to the round or the heart, the smaller shapes. They sit quieter, and they're less likely to clank against the food bowl and start a war.

items.q: Can I put my chihuahua's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes, that's the standard build. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name and your phone number are engraved on the back.

items.q: Will heat, salt air or pool water ruin the engraving?
items.a: No. The words are laser engraved into the metal, not printed on top, so there's nothing to fade or wash off.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
